defensiveAbilities.name: Golden Sun
defensiveAbilities.description: 10 feet. A golden aura envelopes the sanzuwu, protecting them from weak magic. Any non-cold spells of 3rd level or lower burn away and are ineffective. A sanzuwu can deactivate or activate the golden aura as a free action with the concentrate trait.

defensiveAbilities.name: Scorching Gaze
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet targets the sanzuwu or one of their allies with a weapon attack

Effect The sanzuwu focuses their gaze on the triggering creature's weapon, heating it to a burning temperature for an instant. The creature takes 4d8 Fire Damage damage unless the creature Releases the weapon as a free action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fiery Transformation
offensiveAbilities.description: The sanzuwu transforms into an enormous bird made of flame. As the sanzuwu begins their transformation, creatures within a 10ft Emanation take 6d8 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 33 Reflex Saving Throw save). While in their flame form, the sanzuwu gains the effects of 4th-rank Enlarge. They can use Fiery Transformation again to revert back to their standard form.

offensiveAbilities.name: Radiant Blast
offensiveAbilities.description: The sanzuwu opens their mouth to produce a bead of burning energy, hurling it a point within 200 feet. The bead detonates, dealing 7d8 Fire Damage|options:area-damage]{7d8 fire damage and 4d10 sonic damage} to all creatures in a 30ft Burst (Basic DC 33 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail become Blinded for 1 round. The sanzuwu can't use Radiant Blast again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Scorch Earth
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The sanzuwu is standing on the ground

Effect The sanzuwu Strides. A 6th-rank Wall of Fire appears in all the spaces the sanzuwu left during this movement, lasting for 1 round. The sanzuwu can't use Scorch Earth again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Transfixing Sunbeam
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The sanzuwu is in their fiery form

Effect The sanzuwu spreads their wings, emitting a bright cascade of light in a 30ft Cone. Creatures in the cone must attempt a DC 33 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Stunned 1.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned 2.
